messages:
ash: design sync: playground chat streaming UX. goal: reduce visual churn while keeping controls discoverable and accessible. main points to decide: 1) single control that toggles Stop/Resume vs separate Stop + Regenerate, 2) token counter visibility during streaming, 3) small inline prompt-library affordance to 'save snippet' mid-stream, 4) accessible announcements for partial content and resume. devon: my vote: separate controls. Stop should immediately pause the stream; Regenerate (full rerun) lives in footer. a single toggle is confusing for power users. jamie: agree on separate controls. UI idea: show a compact pill cluster that includes [partial badge] [~120 tokens] [stop icon] on hover; otherwise show only the partial badge to keep things clean. also inline "Save snippet" as a ghost button while streaming for quick saves to prompt library. nish: engineering notes: the save-snippet action should capture the current content snapshot and prompt metadata client-side and send to /api/prompt-saves. saving mid-stream should not interrupt the stream. we can add a small optimistic UI animation. token counter: compute cheap visible tokens client-side, and request billable estimate in background for tooltip. priya: a11y: per-message aria-live="polite" for content updates. when user stops, set focus to the message actions container and announce "Streaming paused; final partial content available." For save-snippet, announce "Snippet saved" with role=status. If user saves mid-stream, ensure selection/focus doesn't jump for keyboard users. Example SR-friendly markup:
Streaming
. ash: copy question: use 'Pause stream' vs 'Stop stream'? Pause implies resume is easy. devon: prefer 'Pause stream' for clarity. toast uses 'Paused Resume' copy. regenerate label stays 'Regenerate'. jamie: UX microcopy: token pill reads "~120 tokens" while streaming. tooltip header "Token breakdown" with two lines: Visible / Billable (estimate). save-snippet tooltip: "Save current response to Prompt Library". nish: keyboard shortcuts: Esc or Ctrl+K to pause, R to regenerate (when message focused), S to save snippet. make sure shortcuts are discoverable in a help overlay. priya: screen reader nuance: announcing "Streaming" repeatedly can be noisy. use aria-live polite and throttle announcements to once per 1s. when resuming announce "Resuming stream" and set aria-atomic on resumed fragment to false so only new text is read. also add sr-only labels for the token pill ("Visible tokens: 120; Estimated billable: 200"). ash: implementation plan: 1) show partial badge always, reveal pill cluster on hover/focus, 2) save-snippet ghost button visible on hover/focus and accessible via keyboard, 3) throttle live-region updates, 4) background billable estimate. I'll spin a prototype this sprint. ash: analytics: tag events: pause_method (button/shortcut), resume_source (undo/keyboard), save_snippet (midstream/end), token_tooltip_open. jamie: I'll update mocks to show hover/focus states + mobile fallback (inline footer actions on small widths). mobile save-snippet goes into the message menu (three-dot). priya: I'll write a quick a11y test checklist: 1) live region throttling 2) focus after pause 3) save-snippet announced 4) resumed fragment not re-read 5) token tooltip keyboard accessible. ash: decision: Pause stream terminology, separate Regenerate in footer, reveal token+controls on hover/focus, add Save snippet mid-stream, accessible announcements with throttled live region. Review scheduled tomorrow 10am PT after proto + mocks. thanks all :raised_hands: aria-bot: accessibility scan: detected aria-live usage. recommend documenting throttle behavior and keyboard focus flow in PR description.
